item.title: Middle East Eye: Battle in Yemen's Taiz kills scores of combatants, report says
item.description: Battle in Yemen's Taiz kills scores of combatants, report says Yemen's Houthis and Saudi-backed forces fought over an area near a waterway crucial to global energy flows, killing 80 combatants over the past day, sources on both sides told AFP on Friday. Fighting in Taiz has raged since the Iran-aligned Houthis began a lightning offensive against the internationally-recognised, Saudi-backed government. item.title: Middle East Eye: Trump says US not ‘doing the export ban’
item.description: Trump says US not ‘doing the export ban’ US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he will not authorise an export ban on diesel, hours after G7 countries agreed to release diesel and crude oil from their emergency reserves. G7 countries agreed on Friday to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude.

item.description: Israeli military conducts explosion in southern Lebanon Israeli army carried out two large explosions in the southern Lebanon town of Majdal Zoun, located in the Tyre District, Lebanon’s state-run National News Agency has reported. Details on the explosions, including possible casualties or damage, remain unclear.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Artillery attack injures six people, including two children, in Yemen’s Taiz
item.description: Artillery attack injures six people, including two children, in Yemen’s Taiz Six civilians, including two children and a woman, have been wounded in artillery shelling of residential neighbourhoods in central Taiz, Yemen’s state-run Saba news agency reported, citing local sources. Saba reported that the shelling, which it attributed to the Houthis, hit the Old Airport and Wadi al-Qadi areas.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Houthis say Saudi forces launched 94 strikes in Yemen in 24 hours
item.description: Houthis say Saudi forces launched 94 strikes in Yemen in 24 hours Yemen's Houthis said on Friday that Saudi forces launched 94 strikes against areas under their control in the past 24 hours, as the Iran-aligned group and the Riyadh-backed government clash in the countrys revived civil war. The group said that the number of Saudi strikes on its positions had reached 1,350 since the start of the renewed fighting, saying they targeted areas across Houthi-held Yemen.

item.description: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed three missiles launched by Houthis The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said ‌on Friday that it had intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis towards the southern Saudi city of Khamis Mushait.

item.description: Iraq given US exemption for Iranian flights to and from holy city The United States has granted sanctions exemptions for some Iranian airlines to operate flights to Iraq's holy city of Najaf, the Iraqi prime minister's office said on Friday. It said Baghdad had secured "an agreement allowing Iranian airlines, with the exception of Mahan Air, to operate 40 flights daily to and from Najaf" , a city sacred to Shia Muslims. item.title: Middle East Eye: Turkey's defence ministry condemns Houthi drone attack on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Turkey's defence ministry condemns Houthi drone attack on Saudi Arabia Turkey's defence ministry condemned a Houthi drone attack targeting Saudi Arabia and other actions by the group, calling for an end to such acts that threaten regional stability. The ministry said the continued Houthi threat in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab was affecting not only regional security but also international maritime trade and global stability.
